title: Ember: The Long Way Home (short format)
_note: FLOW clips = 5 x 4 s Veo 3.1 Lite (10 credits each = 50 credits, one day). Scenes without a clip use 'image' and are animated locally for free. A scene with a clip ignores 'image'.

scenes.text: Ember was born where the wind never stopped running.
scenes.caption: ولد إمبر حيث لا تتوقف الرياح عن الجري.

scenes.text: One night, a storm tore the canyon apart, and his herd was gone.
scenes.caption: في ليلة واحدة مزقت العاصفة الوادي، واختفى قطيعه.

scenes.text: Men found him. A rope took his freedom.
scenes.caption: وجده رجال، وسلبه حبلٌ حريته.

scenes.text: But in his dreams, a gentle voice still called him home.
scenes.caption: لكن في أحلامه، كان صوت رقيق ما زال ينادي عليه ليعود.

scenes.text: One storm, one snapped rope, and Ember ran.
scenes.caption: عاصفة واحدة، وحبل ينقطع، وإمبر يركض.

scenes.text: On a quiet ridge at sunrise, he heard a neigh. The herd had never stopped waiting.
scenes.caption: على تلة هادئة عند الشروق، سمع صهيلًا. القطيع لم يتوقف عن الانتظار.
